name: crystal-ball-themes
description: Swap themed video sets on a USB 'electronic crystal ball' display (ArtInChip EVDO-M4) without touching its firmware.
author: JP Caparas <jp@jpcaparas.com>

scripts.themes: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/make_halloween.py assets/themes/halloween
scripts.icon: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pillow --with numpy python tools/make_icon.py assets/icon
